method: Equal-trial weighted phase-local velocity fits; no time normalization.
phase_rule: Last zero-speed sample before the last maximum; brake to first subsequent zero, or record end.
notes: Raw files and Kalman code are unchanged.
Intervals and subsets are modeling selections, not edits to recorded data.
RPM fits are empirical phase curves, not identified transmission gears.
No constant-speed road-load fuel measurement is available.
